inlines.v: TROUBLESOME, adjective trub'lsome. Giving trouble or disturbance; molesting; annoying; vexatious. In warm climates, insects are very troublesome 1. Burdensome; tiresome; wearisome. My mother will never be troublesome to me. 2. Giving inconvenience to. I wish not to be troublesome as a guest. 3. Teasing; importunate; as a troublesome applicant.
